title: Ultra-High-Resolution Modelling Reveals the Complexity of Evolving Shear Band Networks
description: Scripts that reproduce the results of the publication 'Ultra-High-Resolution Modelling Reveals the Complexity of Evolving Shear Band Networks' (Aellig et al., Geodynamica). They run the 2D visco-elasto-viscoplastic shear-band models, from 64² to 40946² cells, on GPUs with JustRelax.jl, and compute every figure and table of the publication from the model output.
notes: Funding: PSA and BJPK were supported by the European Research Council through the MAGMA project, ERC Consolidator Grant #771143. AdM, LR, and IU were supported by the Platform for Advanced Scientific Computing (PASC) project ∂GPU4GEO and by grants from the Swiss National Supercomputing Centre (CSCS) under project ID c44, sm109.
